text:
rachel: quick flag: our new Next.js LangChain + LlamaIndex starter is flaking in the eval suite. The embeddings batch sometimes returns results in a different order and once left out an item after a retry.
tony: ugh. which sample path & sdk?
rachel: samples/next-llama-langchain-starter, using @redwood/sdk@0.9.x (Node). Python consumers not affected.
vishal: any reproducible log snippet?
rachel: yep pasted small excerpt: 
```
payload ids: [u1,u2,u3,u4]
responses observed: [u1,u3,u2]
retry happened -> returned [u2]
final merged: [u1,u3,u2,u2]  // u4 missing, u2 duplicated
```
priya: looks like two problems: (1) the JS batch resolves as promises complete so ordering can shuffle, (2) retry merge appends duplicates instead of re-inserting at the original index.
tony: for evals we need deterministic output. Short-term: add a sample-side postprocess that maps by client id and then reorders. Longer-term: fix SDK.
priya: I pushed a tiny sample patch that normalizes results in api/embeds.ts and gated it behind SAMPLE_STABLE_EMBEDS=true in .env so we don't change runtime semantics for everyone. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/7001
devex-bot: preview deploy for pr/7001 created  status: pending
vishal: good. I'll file an SDK issue for parity and include a small repro payload that the eval harness can run.
tony: create issue and label sdk/parity/bug, please. Also include a unit that simulates an auth error mid-batch to exercise the retry merging logic.
vishal: opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/1988  title: "Node SDK: batch embeddings may reorder and duplicate on partial retry"  labels: sdk,bug,parity
devex-bot: issue #1988 created by vishal  labels: sdk,bug,parity
priya: plan for SDK fix: allocate an array of placeholders sized to input, fill slots as responses arrive (by index) and ignore duplicate client ids on retry. Expose opt-in flag `preserveInputOrder=true` for now; if perf looks fine we can make it the default.
tony: please add microbenchmarks at 100 qps and 500 qps to quantify overhead. We need numbers for release notes.
rachel: sample PR is green locally but CI preview failed because the eval harness caught the mismatch (expected). So gating with env var protects release until SDK fix lands.
devex-bot: preview deploy for pr/7001 rolled back  reason: ci/tests:eval-harness failed
vishal: assign @tony to the SDK patch, @priya to add harness tests that assert: all ids present, no duplicates, and preserved order. I'll own the sample follow-up to remove the gate when the SDK fix merges.
priya: adding harness test: run with concurrency 8 and assert stable ordering across 20 iterations to catch flakiness. Also add a dedupe-by-id guard to avoid false positives while the SDK is in progress.
tonY: will draft an SDK PR that implements placeholder-array + id-based dedupe. I'll include a changelog note about preserving input order for batch endpoints and a migration snippet for anyone relying on unordered behavior.
rachel: also added a section in the Next.js starter README describing the repro steps and the temporary env workaround so community contributors don't keep opening duplicate issues.
devex-bot: linked issue #1988 in samples PR 7001  comment: "SDK issue tracked; remove workaround after SDK patch"
vishal: once SDK PR lands we should update the sample and add an integration test to prevent regression. Also update devex checklist: "assume JS batch may reorder unless preserveInputOrder=true".
priya: final note: watch out for key rotation/401 mid-batch because that triggers a retry that historically caused duplication. Added that as an item in issue #1988.
tonY: PR incoming this week, will ping eng-ml for review and include bench results.
rachel: thanks all — keeping the sample gate until SDK lands to keep eval CI stable.
